verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no in-product feature that generates AI insights or suggestions from the user's own data. Bedrock and AgentCore are developer building blocks for building generative AI apps and agents. The Cost Explorer dashboards offer user-built analysis, not AI-generated insights. CLI suggestions are only tab-completion of command names. None of these count as the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
